en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large steel railway bridge under construction over a river in a valley. Extensive scaffolding and trestle work support the structure, and a steam locomotive with carriages is crossing the finished section. Trees, a dirt road with a simple fence, and water flowing below are visible. At the top right there is printed Swedish text describing the bridge and its dimensions.
